map.计算日排放量与污染物排放总量，辅助环保合规评估: Compute daily wastewater discharge and total pollutant load for environmental compliance and discharge permit accounting.
map.日排放量 = 流量(m³/h) × 运行小时数；年排放量 = 日排放量 × 年运: Daily discharge = flow (m³/h) × operating hours; annual discharge = daily discharge × operating days; pollutant load (kg) = concentration (mg/L) × volume (m³) / 1000
map.单位换算：1 m³ = 1000 L，浓度 mg/L × 1000 L = 10: Unit conversion: 1 m³ = 1000 L; concentration mg/L × 1000 L = 1000 mg = 1 g, hence kg = mg/L × m³ / 1000. The six items COD, BOD₅, ammonia nitrogen, total phosphorus, suspended solids and total nitrogen are each converted by the formula above into daily discharge and annual total load, for corporate environmental compliance, discharge permits and total-load accounting; the results are not a basis for monitoring reports.
map.= 排水量 × 浓度（单位换算：mg/L × m³ = g）: = discharge volume × concentration (unit conversion: mg/L × m³ = g)
map.COD：化学需氧量，衡量水中有机物污染程度: COD: chemical oxygen demand, a measure of organic pollution in water
map.BOD5：五日生化需氧量，反映可生物降解有机物含量: BOD5: five-day biochemical oxygen demand, reflecting the biodegradable organic content
map.氨氮/总氮/总磷：水体富营养化关键指标: Ammonia nitrogen / total nitrogen / total phosphorus: key indicators of water eutrophication
map.⚠️ 数据仅供估算参考，实际排放以环境监测部门检测结果为准。: ⚠️ Data are for estimation reference only; the actual discharge is subject to the test results of the environmental monitoring authority.
map.排放核算：录入流量与浓度，求 COD/氨氮等年排放量。: Emission accounting: enter the flow and concentrations to obtain the annual loads of COD, ammonia nitrogen and other pollutants.
map.许可比对：对比许可排放量，判断是否超总量。: Permit comparison: compare with the permitted discharge amount to judge whether the total load is exceeded.
map.教学演示：演示流量×浓度得负荷。: Teaching demo: demonstrate that flow × concentration gives the load.
map.示例：排放 500 m³/d、COD 300 mg/L，日负荷=500×0.3=: Example: a discharge of 500 m³/d at COD 300 mg/L gives a daily load of 500×0.3 = 150 kg COD.
